svg.title: Relationships between broadcast models
svg.desc: Arrows point from weaker to stronger guarantees. Best-effort broadcast to reliable broadcast; reliable broadcast to FIFO broadcast and independently to total order broadcast; FIFO broadcast to causal broadcast; causal broadcast and total order broadcast each to FIFO-total order broadcast. Causal and total order broadcast are incomparable. The reliable-broadcast box is labelled Reliable broadcast (gossip).
svg.metadata: Redrawn from the user-supplied Martin Kleppmann lecture slide. Styling matches the supplied message-ordering SVG: black and white, square boxes, Latin Modern Sans, and matching arrowheads. Typeset with LaTeX and TikZ; all text is preserved as vector glyph outlines.
